text:
Elaine: heads-up — noticed the new next starter (sandbox) has a bad auth/retry pattern. If you spin up ~50 concurrent requests to /api/generate it looks like everyone's hitting token refresh at once and we get a thundering herd + 429s from hosted API.
Sam: ugh that sounds like our auth client is being recreated per request. can you paste logs?
Elaine: log snippet:
```
INFO request=924 auth=refresh:start session=abcd
INFO request=925 auth=refresh:start session=abcd
ERROR request=926 api=hosted status=429 body="rate limit"
...
```
Mike: yep — classic token rotation storm. starter sample creates a new AuthClient inside the API handler so every serverless invocation races to refresh.
Jordan: quick mitigation: add a mutex or singleton for auth client + exponential backoff + jitter on retries. also rate-limit refresh attempts per session id.
Sam: small repro note: this is visible on Vercel edge functions too because the module reload pattern there can still spawn multiple refreshers under load.
Elaine: I hacked the sample to export a single client from libs/auth.ts and it reduced the failures on my load test. snippet i used: 
```
// libs/auth.ts
import { RedwoodAuth } from 'redwood-sdk'
const authClient = new RedwoodAuth(process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY)
export default authClient
```
// in /api/generate -> import authClient from '../../libs/auth'
Jordan: for retries, we should recommend a backoff like: 
```
const maxRetries = 5
for (let i=0;i<maxRetries;i++){
  try { return await callGenerate() }
  catch (e) {
    if (!isRefreshError(e)) throw e
    await sleep((2**i) * 100 + jitter())
  }
}
```
Mike: gonna propose an SDK change: make token refresh use an internal promise-lock so parallel refresh attempts await a single refresh instead of sending N refresh requests. I'll open a PR.
DevexBot: New PR opened by Mike: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1984 :rocket: (CI queued)
Sam: also suggests we add a tiny note in starter README about singletons for long-running servers and edge-function caveats.
Elaine: filing an issue for the starter with repro steps + patch attached. I'll update the sample to use libs/auth.ts and add test harness for 50-concurrency.
Jordan: quick checklist: SDK lock + starter singleton + README note + example backoff snippet + e2e concurrency test.
Mike: timeline — aiming to land SDK fix today, update starter tomorrow.
Elaine: thanks all — reduced incident surface if we push the fix and a small post-merge note. :thumbsup:
Sam: +1. I'll follow up on the e2e test infra flakiness after this. :eyes:
